'''Ember''' is a 6★ [[Heat]] [[Defender]] [[Operator]] from the [[Order of Steel Oath]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is a [[Great Sword]] user who attacks a target hitting the controlled operator while giving HP treatment to the latter. Her ultimate also grants a {{G|Shield|Shield}} to every teammate.

==Profile==
"Let's move. War never ends. We can only march on."<br/>Ember serves in the [[Order of Steel Oath]], a military force stationed year-round in the rugged northern regions. To recruit successors for fallen comrades, she returned to the [[Civilization Band]] and accepted an invitation to work with [[Endfield Industries]].<br/>An elite of the Assault Banner in the Order of Steel Oath, Ember fights with flawless skills. She leads every charge, tearing through enemy lines alongside her comrades like an unbreakable spear. To her enemies, she is the bulwark that holds firm. To her allies, she is the wall that never falls. The Order may rest on fortresses and battlecarriers — but warriors like Ember are its true backbone.<br/>"Beneath the aurora lie the defense lines of the Oathkeepers."
